evidence.frame_definition: Explicit offline local frame: scene +X chosen local N, +Y chosen -E, +Z chosen -D; scene origin retained. Not surveyed North/East or real calibration. Body COM and FLU from source model. Sensor alignment retains historical heading FAIL.
evidence.clock_definition: Same native sim clock start=0, integer ticks dt=0.0001s; source time_ns rounds seconds to nearest ns. Identity mapping on that representation; raw floats retained. No inferred wall/boot mapping.
evidence.quality_scope: Estimator validity is availability only; trusted=false and covariance unavailable, not calibrated confidence.
evidence.replay_scope: Data replay only. Archived original sources preserved; no current runtime/physics rerun equivalence claimed.
